lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na4Co2Ag2S8 (reduced formula Na2CoAgS4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Ag each in tetrahedral environments coordinated by four S atoms, while Na adopts an octahedral environment with six S neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Co tetrahedra and Na octahedra, and between Ag tetrahedra and Na octahedra, with edge-sharing between Na octahedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
